title: Cumulative customer revenue share, 2025
prompt: The VP wants each customer's cumulative lifetime revenue as of each month in 2025, alongside what share of total company revenue-to-date that represents. What stages of granularity do you need to get there?
population: All completed orders (all-time, so cumulative totals are correct) and their order_items.
grain: order_item → order → customer × month revenue → customer × month running total (window) → company × month running total → final: customer × month with share-of-cumulative-total, for 2025 months.
metricDefinition: cumulative revenue per customer through each month, divided by cumulative company-wide revenue through that same month, restricted to 2025 months in the output.
transformationPlan: aggregate order_items to customer × month revenue (completed orders only, all-time)
compute each customer's running total across months (window function)
aggregate customer × month revenue up to company × month, then compute the company's running total
join customer running totals to company running totals by month and divide
keep only 2025 months in the final output
referenceSql: WITH customer_month AS (SELECT o.customer_id, date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id, date_trunc('month', o.order_date)), customer_running AS (SELECT customer_id, month, sum(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_customer_revenue FROM customer_month), company_month AS (SELECT month, sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM customer_month GROUP BY month), company_running AS (SELECT month, sum(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_company_revenue FROM company_month) SELECT cr.customer_id, cr.month, cr.cumulative_customer_revenue, co.cumulative_company_revenue, cr.cumulative_customer_revenue / co.cumulative_company_revenue AS share_of_cumulative FROM customer_running cr JOIN company_running co ON co.month = cr.month WHERE cr.month >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY cr.month, cr.customer_id
